newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Delta Electron rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Delta Electron rated buy.

text.p: Asset Plus Securities recommended on Monday that investors buy Delta Electronics (Thailand) Plc stocks as the company's sales were expected to grow by about 27 percent during the first quarter this year.

"Delta's sales have been averaging between one billion baht and 1.1 billion baht per month since October 1996, implying quarterly sales of over 3.0 billion baht," said Asset Plus in a research report.
